situations.headline: EV Resources begins live antimony ore crushing at Tecomatlán, targeting first concentrate within ~6.5 weeks

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: EV Resources begins live antimony ore crushing at Tecomatlán, targeting first concentrate within ~6.5 weeks (interest 6, risk 7)

thesis.text: EVR is a speculative near-term antimony producer whose value hinges on successfully converting third-party regional ore into marketable concentrate at Tecomatlán; the current POC crushing milestone is a necessary but not sufficient step, with grade/marketability and offtake economics still unproven, and permanent capital loss risk remains high pending assay results and financing continuity.
